title: 七夕（たなばた）- The Tanabata Legend / Japanese Culture Explained with Vtuber
description: A Vtuber-style explanation of the Tanabata legend (七夕), a classic Japanese folktale celebrated on July 7th. Tells the story of Orihime (織姫) and Hikoboshi (彦星), two lovers separated by the Milky Way who can meet only once a year. Covers the legend's origins, the modern Tanabata festival celebration, and the tradition of writing wishes on tanzaku (短冊) strips of paper. Designed for learners interested in Japanese folklore and seasonal culture.
